coordinate_system: normalized 0-1; x from left, y from top; north up

authority.rule: All subordinate geometry must fit the authoritative continental artwork. Never infer sovereignty from terrain, trade, cultural identity, or maritime reach.
authority.geometry_policy: No polygon or line coordinates are supplied where boundaries or exact courses remain unresolved. Records in this registry are planning/canon records, not a live import layer.

layer_categories.label: Political territories
layer_categories.visual_rule: Distinct restrained fills with non-overlapping boundaries; disputed areas require a separate dated status.
layer_categories.geometry_policy: Only draw after exact boundaries are canonically approved.

layer_categories.label: Geographic regions
layer_categories.visual_rule: Neutral hatching, boundary strokes, or low-opacity shading distinct from political fills.
layer_categories.geometry_policy: Broad illustrative extents may be mapped after visual calibration; regions may cross political borders.

layer_categories.label: Maritime influence
layer_categories.visual_rule: Sea-only tint, sea lanes, patrol reach, or naval influence marks.
layer_categories.geometry_policy: Must not imply ownership of coastal settlements; exact reach remains unresolved unless specified.

layer_categories.label: Roads and trade routes
layer_categories.visual_rule: Separate line styles for established, approximate, and proposed routes.
layer_categories.geometry_policy: Only established routes may be shown as solid routes.

layer_categories.label: Settlements and sites
layer_categories.visual_rule: Stable source IDs and player-visibility flags; markers link to canonical location records.
layer_categories.geometry_policy: Place against calibrated artwork; no invented coordinates.

political_regions.name: House Veyr
political_regions.notes: Northern dynasty. Exact borders are not established.

political_regions.name: House Vaelorian
political_regions.notes: Elven Great House. Exact borders are not established.

political_regions.name: House Edarth
political_regions.notes: Primarily human Great House. Exact borders are not established.

political_regions.name: House Calderan
political_regions.notes: Human ruling dynasty associated with the Crownlands and Imperial Seat. Exact borders are not established.

political_regions.name: House Kharadorn
political_regions.broad_area: Northeastern dominion and central Inland Sea dominion
political_regions.notes: The central Inland Sea dominion is a maritime sphere and must not be rendered as sovereignty over every shoreline settlement.

political_regions.name: House Merrowen
political_regions.broad_area: Northern Coast, Eastern Shore, Great Delta, Southern Coast
political_regions.notes: Extended maritime reach does not mean control of every eastern port or coastal settlement.

geographic_regions.name: Southwestern Marches
geographic_regions.feature_type: arid highlands, dry valleys, plateaus and oases
geographic_regions.notes: Geographic zone, not a unified kingdom.

geographic_regions.name: Southern Principalities
geographic_regions.feature_type: fertile lowlands, forests, rivers, small hereditary kingdoms and independent cities
geographic_regions.notes: A broad geographic-cultural zone containing multiple polities, not one state.

geographic_regions.name: Southern Islands
geographic_regions.feature_type: island chains, sheltered harbors, fishing settlements and maritime principalities

maritime_regions.name: Kharadorn Central Inland Sea Dominion
maritime_regions.notes: Represent on water only. Does not automatically place every shoreline settlement under direct Kharadorn administration.

maritime_regions.name: Merrowen Maritime Reach
maritime_regions.notes: Does not imply sovereignty over every eastern port.

route_layers.name: Continental Major Road Network
route_layers.notes: Draw established major corridors between major places. Exact courses remain subject to cartographic tracing and GM review.

map_scale_policy.continental: Major cities, Great House seats and strongholds, major ports, and continent-scale roads only. Minor regional settlements belong on regional maps.
map_scale_policy.regional: Settlements, local landmarks, established roads, and local political jurisdictions belonging to that region.
map_scale_policy.nested_detail: City maps contain districts, gates, streets, walls, and street-level features.

regional_jurisdiction_policy.rule: Distinguish direct holdings, vassalage, charter rights, and strategic interests. None automatically establishes sovereignty over all surrounding land.
